description: OnsiteOkine is developing a self-deactivating cytokine platform technology aimed at enhancing immunotherapeutic treatments for cancer by targeting tumor tissues and minimizing systemic side effects.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Chair of Cellular Protein Biochemistry at TUM

funding_summary: The project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC), including an ERC Proof-of-Concept Grant to advance its application.
inflection_why_now: The recent ERC Proof-of-Concept Grant signifies a critical juncture, providing the necessary funding to transition from basic research to practical application in cancer immunotherapy.
devils_advocate_risks: Clinical Validation: Ensuring the modified interleukin-12 variant's efficacy and safety in human trials.
Regulatory Approval: Navigating complex regulatory pathways for new immunotherapeutic agents.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: As a pharmaceutical company with a focus on innovative therapies, they could provide expertise and resources to advance OnsiteOkine's therapeutic applications.
Specializing in molecular diagnostics, QIAGEN could offer complementary technologies for biomarker analysis and patient stratification in immunotherapy treatments.
